justification: Panel A depicts dense rows of hieroglyphic script accompanied by two kneeling/seated human figures with raised arms, arranged in a formal registered inscription layout; panel B depicts a schematic stick-figure human with raised arms next to a long wavy line (snake or path) and a couple of dots, arranged sparsely across an open rock surface. The only faint commonality is a human figure with raised arms, but its form, context, surrounding elements (script vs. a serpentine line), density of composition, and rendering convention are entirely different, so there is no meaningful shared iconographic scheme.
